SQS MovieTracker
  • Welcome to MovieTracker Documentation

Welcome to MovieTracker Documentation

MovieTracker is a web application for discovering, tracking, and reviewing movies. It was designed and implemented as the final project for the Software Quality Assurance course, with a strong focus on software architecture, quality attributes, automated testing, and modern development practices.

The application allows users to search for movies, view detailed information, manage a personal watchlist, and share reviews, while integrating with the TMDB API to provide up-to-date movie data.

Getting Started

If you want to run MovieTracker locally, begin with the Quick Start Guide, which explains the prerequisites, installation steps, and available deployment modes.

Documentation Overview

This documentation provides a comprehensive overview of the project, including:

  • Architecture and design decisions

  • Quality goals and quality scenarios

  • Deployment and runtime views

  • Testing strategy and automated test suites

  • Development and operational guidelines

  • Technology stack and external dependencies

Whether you are a developer, reviewer, stakeholder or our teacher, these pages will help you understand how MovieTracker is built, deployed, tested, and maintained.

We hope you find this documentation useful and informative.
